create_dataset_from_config: create a MultiFileVectorDataset from an OIVF config dict and dataset name
memmap_raw_vectors: memmap raw binary or numpy vector files with LRU caching for efficient access
iterate_dataset_batches: iterate over a multi-file vector dataset in batches with optional L2 normalization
get_vectors_by_index: get specific vectors by index from a multi-file dataset with offset resolution
sample_random_vectors: sample n random vectors from the dataset with optional index and vector caching
